items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the two functor equalities at source lines 1435-1446, label lemma-relate-zero-affine, whose proof occupies source lines 1448-1468. The proof is not a citation: it verifies the two base change commutation identities that keep u_T and v_T adjoint after pullback, derives the vanishing equivalence for adjoint pairs, and for the closed immersion case writes the unit factorization of u_T through i_{T,*} and uses exactness and full faithfulness of the direct image to transfer surjectivity. The counted statement records none of this.
